components.gif.title: Inspect a linked instance
components.gif.detail: Browse locked properties. Go to main component opens the shared source.

components.gif.title: Edit the main component
components.gif.detail: The parent library supplies the same card to Light and Dark boards.

components.gif.title: One master edit, every linked use
components.gif.detail: Set Corner to 24. Use linked usages to navigate back to the design.

components.gif.title: The instance inherits Corner = 24
components.gif.detail: The lock keeps this value following its master.

components.gif.title: Override only Corner = 48
components.gif.detail: The orange warning identifies a local value kept on master updates.

components.gif.title: Reset to the latest master
components.gif.detail: Corner returns to 24 and is locked again. Other local overrides stay intact.

colors.gif.title: One Text role, two visible properties
colors.gif.detail: Primary text and the card outline are linked to Text. Background is separate.

colors.gif.title: Open the Text color picker
colors.gif.detail: The schematic belongs to the parent and is shared with child folders.

colors.gif.title: Preview locally while editing
colors.gif.detail: Text and outline change together. Muted text and backgrounds stay unchanged.

colors.gif.title: Primary text + border turn mint green
colors.gif.detail: Text = #8FE1C7. The visible board previews the same role in both places.

colors.gif.title: Save one accepted color change
colors.gif.detail: Save color closes the picker. Other boards use the saved role when opened.

colors.gif.title: One Undo restores both
colors.gif.detail: Ctrl+Z restores the original Text value without changing the background.

themes.gif.title: One shared layout, multiple palettes
themes.gif.detail: Design themes supply values for the same schematic roles.

themes.gif.title: Switch Design theme to Light
themes.gif.detail: The same component IDs and geometry render with the Light values.

themes.gif.title: Switch back to Dark
themes.gif.detail: Theme folders are for optional extras; shared components stay in the parent.

layout-css.gif.title: Start from the editable master
layout-css.gif.detail: Inherited instance CSS stays locked unless explicitly overridden.

layout-css.gif.title: Generate JSX + real CSS
layout-css.gif.detail: Stable layer selectors connect the stylesheet to native design properties.

layout-css.gif.title: Edit the CSS values
layout-css.gif.detail: Change border-radius to 12px and gap to 20px, then Apply CSS to design.

layout-css.gif.title: Apply one atomic design edit
layout-css.gif.detail: The editor saves the stylesheet changes as native component properties.

layout-css.gif.title: Inspect Corner = 12 and Gap = 20
layout-css.gif.detail: Both values are now native fields on the master.

layout-css.gif.title: Linked uses inherit the CSS change
layout-css.gif.detail: The instance receives 12 / 20 and remains read-only for those properties.

comments.gif.title: Pin feedback to a linked component
comments.gif.detail: Comments annotate the design without editing inherited component values.

comments.gif.title: Save the feedback thread
comments.gif.detail: The pin stays anchored to its design layer.

comments.gif.title: Reply with implementation guidance
comments.gif.detail: Explain shared masters and role bindings in the same thread.

comments.gif.title: Resolve completed feedback
comments.gif.detail: The Resolved filter lets you revisit closed threads.
